blocks.value:
Create your own investing checklist:

✅ Emergency Fund
✅ Health Insurance
✅ Clear High-Interest Debt
✅ Define Financial Goals
✅ Decide Asset Allocation
✅ Invest Regularly
✅ Review Every 6–12 Months
A written investment plan helps you stay disciplined during market ups and downs.

blocks.question: Why should every investor have an investment plan?
